title: The Totals row sums the Adjustments column across the tab's visible jobs
refs: SV-9282 (WIP spec v22 2026-08-18 S6-R2 — Totals row sums each visible money column including Adjustments)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
  2. Several open work orders with work-order-level fees or discounts appear on the current tab.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report.
  2. Scroll to the Totals row pinned at the bottom of the tab.
  3. Read the Adjustments cell in the Totals row.
expected:
1. The Totals row includes an Adjustments cell.
2. It equals the sum of the Adjustments values of the tab's visible jobs.
3. It uses the same signed money format as the column (fees add, discounts subtract).

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and story SV-9282, and the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (S6-R2), read on 18 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
